title: Multi-model quantization output telemetry & canary harness for FP8/INT8 structured-call fidelity
creator: Aisha Rahman
description:
Build an automated harness and canary pipeline that measures structured output (JSON/function-call) fidelity across multiple models and quantization profiles (FP8, INT8). The goal is to produce per-model, per-profile telemetry, create calibrated rollouts and automated rollback rules, and generate reproducible failing examples for remediation.

Scope: instrument inference runtime to produce detailed deltas (schema violations, field-level value errors, parse failures, tokenization shifts) across: base FP32 reference, FP8 profiles (e4m1, e4m2), and INT8 symmetric/asymmetric profiles. Integrate with existing eval bench and Console dashboards for per-route SLOs and alerting. Deliver a canary job that runs on every quant-profile promotion and a small UI in Console showing pass/fail and examples.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry pipeline captures schema_violation_rate, parse_failure_rate, function_call_mismatch_rate, field_level_numeric_mse, and token_boundary_shift per model/profile per 1k requests.
Quantization canary job runs as part of CI/CD and flags any profile with >0.5% absolute increase in schema_violation_rate versus FP32 baseline or >1.0% relative increase in field_level_numeric_mse.
Canary produces reproducible minimal prompt set (<=100 examples) that trigger failures and stores them in a searchable artifact bucket with metadata (seed, profile, model, input hash).
Console dashboard surfaces per-route trend lines and a quick 'Promote / Hold' with links to failing examples and suggested remediation (recalibration, profile rollback, model variant fallback).
Alerting integrates with oncall: PagerDuty trigger when critical route exceeds 1% schema violations for 30 minutes or 5% parse failures in any 1 hour window.
steps: Design telemetry schema and minimal metric definitions with RTB (Marco, Aisha) and Runtime team.
Instrument runtime to emit paired-sample reports for each request: reference_response and quant_response with deterministic seed when applicable.
Implement a canary job in CI that deploys a background canary runner to Dedicated/Private targets with traffic mirroring (1% synthetic) and compares outputs.
Develop automated minimizer that reduces failing prompts to minimal repros and stores artifacts in GCS/OSS bucket with labels.
Integrate metrics into Console: add per-profile lanes, scatter plots for numeric deltas, table of top failing examples with 're-run' and 'export' actions.
Define rollout policy: auto-hold if thresholds breached; auto-promote if stable for 48h and <0.1% delta on critical routes.
Write monitoring playbook and incident runbook for oncall (how to triage failures, run recalibration, revert quant-profile).
comments: 2026-03-01: Aisha: Initial scoping with Runtime and Console teams. Identified need for deterministic replay tokenization to compare outputs reliably.
2026-03-04: Marco: POC for paired-sample reports completed. Early surprise: INT8 asymmetric profiles showed token-boundary shifts on long chat contexts.
2026-03-06: Kavita (QA): Suggested adding field-level fuzzy matching thresholds for floating values to avoid false positives from rounding.
2026-03-09: Design review: added UX row to Console for 'Example telemetry -> Reproduce' with copyable prompt + seed.
2026-03-12: Security: flagged artifact storage encryption and access controls; added requirement for KMS-wrapped keys for failing example artifacts.
